note: Live-session recording of the screen scenes (series/tools/rec). prepare/teardown run on the laptop, not recorded; commands are typed and run for real. The promote screen is an app screen: CON-FOREST01 is a standalone VM, so PowerShell Direct with the lab CONTOSO credential cannot sign in; the owner signs in at the VMConnect console with the local Administrator.
prepare: Invoke-Command -Session $dc { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force C:\lab | Out-Null; Remove-Item C:\lab\ep02 -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }

if (-not (Invoke-Command -Session $dc { Test-Path "C:\Program Files\PowerShell\7\pwsh.exe" })) { if (-not (Test-Path $msi)) { Invoke-WebRequest "https://github.com/PowerShell/PowerShell/releases/download/v$v/PowerShell-$v-win-x64.msi" -OutFile $msi }; Copy-Item -ToSession $dc -Path $msi -Destination C:\lab\pwsh.msi -Force; Invoke-Command -Session $dc { Start-Process msiexec.exe "/i C:\lab\pwsh.msi /quiet ADD_PATH=1 ENABLE_PSREMOTING=1" -Wait } }

if (-not (Invoke-Command -Session $dc { Test-Path C:\lab\ep02-pw.xml })) { $pw = Read-Host -AsSecureString "Lab-only initial password for the demo users (owner types, never shown)"; Invoke-Command -Session $dc -ArgumentList $pw { param($p) $p | Export-Clixml C:\lab\ep02-pw.xml } }
# CON-FOREST01 (throwaway, not domain-joined, private switch MGLab-Isolated) is created by the owner from the lab base image: see needs vm:CON-FOREST01

if (Get-VM -Name CON-FOREST01 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { $fc = [pscredential]::new("Administrator", (Read-Host -AsSecureString "CON-FOREST01 local Administrator password (owner types, never shown)")); $f = New-PSSession -VMName CON-FOREST01 -Credential $fc; Invoke-Command -Session $f { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force C:\lab | Out-Null; Remove-Item C:\lab\ep02 -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }; Copy-Item -ToSession $f -Path (Get-Location).Path -Destination C:\lab\ep02 -Recurse -Force; Invoke-Command -Session $f { Install-WindowsFeature AD-Domain-Services -IncludeManagementTools | Out-Null }; Remove-PSSession $f }

screens.name: promote
screens.app: VMConnect: CON-FOREST01 console (Server Core, isolated switch MGLab-Isolated, never CON-DC01)
steps: Open the console of CON-FOREST01 in VMConnect; the owner signs in as the local Administrator (typed off camera)
Pause on the line "ForestMode values accepted here: ..." and on the Test-ADDSForestInstallation result (Status Success); say whether Win2025 is in the list
Directory Services Restore Mode password is typed off camera (never shown); show the restart prompt and the restart as B-roll

Optional B-roll on this throwaway VM only: Enable-ADOptionalFeature -Identity "Recycle Bin Feature" -Scope ForestOrConfigurationSet -Target lab.contoso.com and show the irreversible-change confirmation only
mask: VMConnect title bar ("<VM> on <laptop name>") and the laptop taskbar
any password prompt (DSRM password) while it is typed

screens.name: provision
commands: Invoke-AdLabProvisioning -CsvPath .\src\users.csv -DomainDn 'DC=lab,DC=contoso,DC=com' -UpnSuffix lab.contoso.com -InitialPassword $pw | Group-Object Action, Type | Format-Table Count, Name
Invoke-AdLabProvisioning -CsvPath .\src\users.csv -DomainDn 'DC=lab,DC=contoso,DC=com' -UpnSuffix lab.contoso.com -InitialPassword $pw | Group-Object Action, Type | Format-Table Count, Name

screens.name: report
prepare: Invoke-Command -VMName CON-DC01 -Credential $cred { $pw = Import-Clixml C:\lab\ep02-pw.xml; $ou = "OU=IT,OU=Users,OU=Contoso,$((Get-ADDomain).DistinguishedName)"; if (-not (Get-ADUser -Filter "SamAccountName -eq 'adm-alex'")) { New-ADUser -Name adm-alex -SamAccountName adm-alex -Path $ou -AccountPassword $pw -Enabled $true }; Add-ADGroupMember -Identity "Domain Admins" -Members adm-alex, iferreira }
# SDProp is started by hand instead of waiting 60 minutes; iferreira then keeps adminCount=1 after leaving Domain Admins

Invoke-Command -VMName CON-DC01 -Credential $cred { $r = [ADSI]"LDAP://CON-DC01/RootDSE"; $r.Put("runProtectAdminGroupsTask", 1); $r.SetInfo(); Start-Sleep -Seconds 20; (Get-ADUser iferreira -Properties adminCount).adminCount; Remove-ADGroupMember -Identity "Domain Admins" -Members iferreira -Confirm:$false }

screens.name: lastlogon
prepare: # owner signs in: at the VMConnect console of CON-SRV02 sign in as CONTOSO\jgoncalves (first sign-in forces the password change), sign out; wait about 5 minutes; sign in again; sign out
Read-Host 'Press Enter when both sign-ins are done' | Out-Null
commands: Get-ADUser jgoncalves -Properties lastLogon, lastLogonTimestamp | Select-Object Name, @{ n = 'lastLogon (this DC)'; e = { [datetime]::FromFileTimeUtc($_.lastLogon) } }, @{ n = 'lastLogonTimestamp (repl)'; e = { [datetime]::FromFileTimeUtc($_.lastLogonTimestamp) } } | Format-List

teardown: Invoke-Command -VMName CON-DC01 -Credential $cred { Remove-ADGroupMember -Identity "Domain Admins" -Members adm-alex -Confirm:$false -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; $ou = "OU=Contoso,$((Get-ADDomain).DistinguishedName)"; if (Get-ADOrganizationalUnit -Filter "DistinguishedName -eq '$ou'") { Get-ADOrganizationalUnit -SearchBase $ou -Filter * | Set-ADObject -ProtectedFromAccidentalDeletion $false; Remove-ADOrganizationalUnit -Identity $ou -Recursive -Confirm:$false }; Remove-Item C:\lab\ep02, C:\lab\ep02-pw.xml -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }
Invoke-Command -VMName CON-SRV02 -Credential $cred { Get-CimInstance Win32_UserProfile | Where-Object LocalPath -like "*jgoncalves*" | Remove-CimInstance -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }

$vm = Get-VM -Name CON-FOREST01 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if ($vm) { $disks = @($vm | Get-VMHardDiskDrive | ForEach-Object Path | Where-Object { (Split-Path $_ -Leaf) -like "CON-FOREST01*" }); Stop-VM -VM $vm -TurnOff -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Remove-VM -VM $vm -Force; foreach ($d in $disks) { Get-ChildItem (Split-Path $d) -File -Filter "CON-FOREST01*" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Remove-Item -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue } }
